acceptance: Shared preparation infrastructure declares and checks traversal, exact Ref/Pin dependencies, explicit collection completeness, raw record identity and integrity, and scoped media/intent correspondence through the existing evidence boundary. Its new validators have isolated missing/null/malformed and valid controls, exact diagnostics, and deletion-sensitive tests. It does not expose a partially populated all-rule context as ready.
notes:
eval-pilot lint checks these rules:

Rule	Level	Fires when
E1	error	A decision has no warrant path to a MUST or SHOULD criterion (when intent exists)
E2	error	RECONSTRUCTED or PROMPT_ONLY intent excuses a deviation of MATERIAL or worse
E2w	warning	CONTEMPORANEOUS intent excuses a deviation of MATERIAL or worse
E3	error	Evidence falls outside the decoded timeline
E4	error	A relation kind or purpose is outside the vocabulary
E5	error	A resolution, or an upward confidence revision, rests only on DISCOVERY evidence
E6	error	A frozen test plan fails frozen_digest verification
E7	error	An override has no reason
W1	warning	A motion claim is supported only by still frames
W2	warning	A hand-built exhaustive set has no residual
W3	warning	A hypothesis has no alternative
W4	warning	A stochastic arm has no sample design or decision rule
W5	warning	A relation's purpose is UNSPECIFIED

Snapshots embed the ruleset version and the results. Any error blocks ready.

Acceptance: one TEST-ONLY graph that triggers each rule exactly once, and a clean graph that passes.

Sphoenix, 2026-10-10: fail-closed acceptance appended. Step 0019 remains a genuine REVERT/R0 with its product retry charged.

Appended acceptance:
- Every lint rule declares all evidence fields it requires, and every prerequisite passes through one shared evidence-availability boundary before it may support a clean rule result.
- The shared evidence boundary returns AVAILABLE(value), UNKNOWN(reason) for missing, null or unavailable evidence, or INTEGRITY_FAILURE(reason) for malformed, wrong-type, impossible, corrupt or integrity-invalid evidence. Do not introduce a new INVALID vocabulary.
- Only AVAILABLE may support a clean rule result. UNKNOWN and INTEGRITY_FAILURE each produce an explicit diagnostic and make the result incomplete/not-ready; neither can produce PASS, COMPLETE, SHIP, ready=true or an equivalent clean state.
- One shared parameterized evidence contract test covers every declared prerequisite of every lint rule with missing, null, malformed/wrong-type where representable, and a valid boundary value. Where ordinary admission prevents malformed values, test the raw/read-only path that encounters corrupt retained data.
- Regressions cover null and invalid motion dimensions and null and invalid decoded durations with full-clip evidence, through direct and retained-query paths, with explicit diagnostics and ready=false; valid non-motion context remains supported.
- Use the existing split mechanism if L12 cannot fit the configured 900 changed-line budget. Never remove, loosen or reduce tests to fit.

Operator size decomposition, Sphoenix 2026-10-10 L12 directive: the original all-rule acceptance above is unchanged. These appended subordinate criteria add no new product scope; they make the existing exact-partition split mechanism usable without cutting tests or raising the 900-line cap. Only while planning the unsplit item L12-A2, split before further implementation. Resulting children implement only their assigned acceptance subset; this parent instruction does not request another split of a child whose own scope fits the cap. A practical four-child partition is shared infrastructure; temporal/relation/optional branches; warrant/provenance/override branches; then role/history/frozen/alternative branches plus the original all-rule conjunction. Each child adds focused tests for every new guard; the exhaustive L12-A3 matrix remains a separate, unchanged obligation. Do not present an intermediate subset as complete lint/readiness. Follow the critical-path ordering; no unrelated work may substitute for a blocked prerequisite.

Step 0023 is a genuine evaluated product attempt, preserved with its charged retry. Its rejected candidate and tests are retained in that step's evidence; do not relabel it as harness failure, refund its retry, or treat its green ordinary tests as acceptance. Each child plan must map the findings in loop/reports/STEP-0023/eval_r1.json and eval_r2.json to its owned remedy or remaining sibling obligation. Preserve all previously integrated tests and add the necessary isolated controls; do not remove or loosen controls to meet the cap. Do not use partial coverage deferred to A3 as an excuse for missing tests of newly introduced validators.
